lines.latin: Marhaban bikum fi Qal'at Nizwa (Welcome to Nizwa Fort)

notes: Framed welcome panel above a relief model of the fort, mounted on a wall inside Nizwa Fort. The small brass dedication plate at bottom right (model presented in 1995 by the Ministry of Heritage and Culture) is not transcribed. Same place as c136297390 but a different sign.

author: Taha Al-Hayali
attribution: Photo: Taha Al-Hayali, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Front_View_of_Nizwa_Fort_Entrance.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Gilt lettering on a wooden lunette above the arched entrance, seen from below at mid distance. The Arabic is calligraphic with vowel marks (damma, sukun, superscript alef) that are omitted here. Small brass info plaques beside the door and two cannons are distractors; a visitor walking out is incidental.
source_title: File:Front View of Nizwa Fort Entrance.jpg

author: "dronepicr"

notes: Indoor snow park in Muscat (Mall of Oman). Target is the logo disc with blue 'SNOW OMAN / سنو عمان' label, plus 'WELCOME TO SNOW OMAN' spray-painted on the fake snow rock below, angled and partly glare-hit. Penguin and polar-bear figures are decor. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.
source_title: File:Sign at the entrance of Snow Oman in Muscat, Oman (53698177395).jpg
